fusions.name: Boggy Thrash
fusions.desc: Thrashes with the blade dug in and churns the ground to mud, dealing 28 earth damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each one [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Mudbank Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps the blade shut on the target and rolls it under the mud, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Pit
fusions.desc: Digs a covered pit at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 24 damage.

fusions.name: Sunk to the Eyes
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
